descrizione: An industrial high pressure maintenance water lance for a water park: a thick steel barrel with yellow and black hazard stripes, a big round pressure gauge with a steel bezel on the side, a black pistol grip with a red trigger, a sturdy carry handle on top, a wide steel nozzle with a rubber bumper ring, a short stub of black reinforced hose with a steel crimp fitting at the back. 65 cm long.
